svg.aria-label: Biquadratic change of variable and domain restriction mapping
svg.title: Biquadratic change of variable and domain restriction mapping
svg.desc: Four staged panels: transformation u = x^2, real domain constraint u >= 0, root branching for p(x) with positive roots, and rejection of negative root u = -2 for q(x).

g.text: 1 · Change of variable for biquadratic polynomials
Given polynomials contain only even powers: p(x) = x⁴ - 5x² + 4, q(x) = x⁴ + 4x² + 4
Substitute auxiliary variable: u = x² → convert quartic to quadratic in u
For any real number x ∈ ℝ, its square is non-negative: x² ≥ 0 ⇒ u ≥ 0.
• If u > 0: produces TWO real zeros: x = ±√u
• If u = 0: produces ONE real zero: x = 0
• If u < 0: produces ZERO real zeros (√u is non-real)
3 · Solving p(x): u² - 5u + 4 = 0 ⇒ u = 1 or u = 4
Both u = 1 and u = 4 satisfy u ≥ 0: x = ±√1 = ±1, and x = ±√4 = ±2.
Four accepted real zeros for p(x): {-2, -1, 1, 2}.
q(x) has NO real zeros! Unrestricted u would falsely create imaginary ±√-2 as real roots.
